prompt.zh-CN: 【合规通知】合规官宣布：涉及付款和账户信息的工单一律禁止AI自动回复，必须由人工处理。
prompt.en-US: 【Compliance Notice】The Compliance Officer announces that tickets involving payments and account data are strictly forbidden from AI auto-reply and must be handled by humans.

prompt.zh-CN: 【财务要求】CFO要求：自动化项目必须在下季度证明至少15%的投资回报，否则预算将被削减。
prompt.en-US: 【ROI Requirement】The CFO requires the automation project to prove at least 15% ROI next quarter, or the budget will be cut.

prompt.zh-CN: 【事故报告】质量负责人通报：AI曾对客户错误承诺退款政策，客户投诉在一周内上升了60%。
prompt.en-US: 【Incident Report】The quality lead reports that the AI wrongly promised a refund policy, and customer complaints rose 60% within a week.

prompt.zh-CN: 【流程要求】客服总监要求：所有AI建议都必须保留一键转人工的升级通道，任何自动回复都不能阻塞用户寻求人工帮助。
prompt.en-US: 【Escalation Required】The Support Director requires every AI suggestion to keep a one-click human escalation path, and no auto-reply may block a user from reaching a human.
